staticPrompt: Clear daylight over a small enclosed courtyard, seen from an elevated three-quarter view above a tiled stone floor. Low garden walls enclose the paving, with a short masonry pillar at the centre of the yard. Two wooden packing crates rest on the tiles, and two square brass plates are inlaid in the paving nearby. A garden keeper in a work shirt, trousers and a brimmed hat occupies an open tile. Cypress and shrub planters stand just outside the walls, with a strip of grass along one edge. Clear blue sky, hard midday sun and crisp shadows on the stone.
